info.title: StrategicPlan API
info.description:
Provider-neutral REST facade over the StrategicPlan PostgreSQL reporting contract.
V2.5 documentation snapshot. Cookie security annotations are supplied by the exporter; many responses are untyped at runtime. See API_DOCUMENTATION.md for authorization, legacy routes and errors.
